headline: Heavy Fighting Shakes Palantine Berm and Linn of Mercy Fronts
war_summary: Since our last dispatch, the violent churn across Palantine Berm has only intensified, with ten base transfers logged over the past two hours as fighting sweeps through the Pippeli Stones and Vendett. The northern meatgrinders at Linn of Mercy and the Nevish Line have escalated from mere attrition into direct territorial upheaval; Warden assaults in Linn of Mercy seized Outwich Ranch and Lathair amidst nearly five thousand fresh casualties, while contested ground around Grief Mother in the Nevish Line endured repeated shifts and over four thousand dead. Checkpoint Bua in Marban Hollow continues its stubborn oscillation with four further exchanges in the latest watch. Conversely, the frenzied base captures that recently tore through Weathered Expanse have stalled entirely; not a single position changed hands there in the last two hours, though heavy fighting still claims thousands of casualties. Quiet holds firm over Mooring County and Kuura Strand, where guns have fallen largely dormant.
